artifacts.title: Neighborhood Atlas — initial brief
artifacts.content: Build a practical map that helps residents find walking routes and local services. Make crossings and step-free access easy to understand.

artifacts.title: Route observations
artifacts.content: Compared walking routes, crossings, and access to nearby services. Several notes focus on making the safest path clear to a first-time visitor.

artifacts.title: Map layout sketches
artifacts.content: Early sketches prioritize route clarity and a compact neighborhood index. The page should help someone orient themselves quickly.
